auditDurability.description: storage.database.audit_durability: strict | standard; empty leaves the backend default.

keysSecret.description: Secret mode (docs/multi-replica-keys.md): the key files come read-only from this Secret, created with `keyorix-server admin encryption key-secret generate|export`. Required for server.replicas > 1.

settings.description: Extra postgres -c settings for the bundled PostgreSQL. session_replication_role is refused: anything but 'origin' turns off foreign keys and the triggers Keyorix's caches depend on (#3361).
